claim: AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network connection over which you can mount EFS file systems; once mounted, you can use DataSync to copy data into EFS up to 10 times faster than standard Linux copy tools.

evidence.quote: Once mounted, you can use DataSync to copy data into EFS up to 10 times faster than standard Linux copy tools.
AWS Direct Connect provides a high-bandwidth and lower-latency dedicated network connection over which you can mount your EFS file systems.
